# ZipQuantum mobile examples

> Native, auditable deep-link and deferred-deep-link integration examples with no proprietary SDK and no fingerprinting.

Canonical agent instructions: AGENTS.md
Machine-readable repository map: ai-manifest.json
Mobile response schema: contracts/mobile-v1.schema.json
Integration contract: docs/mobile-contract.md
Agent workflow: docs/agent-integration.md
iOS example: ios-swiftui/README.md
Android example: android-kotlin/README.md

Do not decode or persist deferred tokens or route receipts. Do not read the iOS clipboard silently. Do not introduce device fingerprints or cross-app identifiers.
